content:
The giant Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale rolls alongside one of the best prices to date on AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off the list and the now even lower AirPods Max 2 at $120 off. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features Amazon bringing back all-time low pricing on AirTag 2, up to $220 off Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units, return lows on iPhone Air, this 1TB M3 iPad Air at $400 off right now ($650 under the M4 price), 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air is $300 off courtesy of the official Apple Certified Refurbished storefront, some notable headphones deals, and more. Check it out below.

Best Buy’s massive 60th Anniversary Sale now live to rival Black Friday! Apple, LG TVs, Android gear, 10x rewards, more

Summer AirPods deals just dropped even lower, now up to $120 off

After summer full of solid deals on Apple’s latest AirPods lineup, just about all of them have just dropped even lower. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now sitting at one of the best prices ever at 25% off, but we also saw AirPods 4 with ANC dip to the lowest price in several months and AirPods Max 2 have dropped even lower as of this morning to $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Amazon drops single AirTag 2 listing down to $24, open-box at $20 (Up to 30% off)

While you can still score an open-box unit over at Best Buy for just $20, Amazon has now dropped the price on the single AirTag 2 listing down to $24 Prime shipped to match the best deal we have ever tracked.

The 4-pack still delivers a better per-Tag price of course while it too is back down at the $89 Amazon all-time low, but for those who don’t need four of them the single listing has now dropped a touch lower.

Amazon is now offering a single 2026 model AirTag 2 down at $24 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 “excellent” open-box $20 (Reg. $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (Reg. $99)

You a land an “excellent” condition open-box unit for a single AirTag down at $19.99 shipped right now – that’s 31% off the regular $29 new list price.

And while the new listing we are featuring here today at Amazon is only 17% off, we are also talking about a brand new unit for just $4 more.

When you are talking about a regularly $29 item, the discounts might not seem all that huge, but a deal is a deal and we are looking at offers on par with the very best we have tracked since Apple debuted its all-new AirTag 2.

Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off today (Matching Prime Day deal)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my go-to recommendation for landing deals on iPhone, Apple does not sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like it won’t until after the 18 series lands next month. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing at up to $220 off the new list prices.

Amazon’s top-quality Premium Renewed units have been the best option for landing deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units thus far. Not only are you saving hundreds, but you’re also landing the 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – the not “premium” renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and you won’t get the same battery life grate either.

Right now you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – the 512GB is now $20 less than our previous mention as well:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday top picks from the Apple refurb store feature, you can land a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699 and a 1TB 16 Pro Max at $1,269 – $330 less than the comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (Up to $330 less than series 17)

This 1TB M3 iPad Air is $400 off right now ($650 under the M4 price)

The AirPod Pro 3 deals are flying, AirPods Max 2 is $120 off, and AirTag 2 has returned to its best price ever, but we also wanted to scope out this deep discount on iPad Air at $400 off the original MSRP – you can score this M3 at $650 less than the price of the latest M4.

Deals on the iPad Air lineup have been light lately, and while Amazon is now offering $100 off the new MSRPs, Best Buy has a rather compelling discount live on the M3 iPad Air right now as part of its 60th Anniversary Sale.

A 1TB M4 iPad Air carries a $1,349 list price these days, and is now starting at nearly $1,300 on Amazon.

Aside from the faster M4 chip, the M3 model is nearly identical and is likely more than fast enough for most users – Best Buy has an 11-inch 1TB model at $699 right now, or $650 less than the list price on an M4:

  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air 1TB $699 (Orig. $1,099)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB from $1292 (Reg. $1,349)

Not only is this 1TB M3 iPad Air drastically less than the price of the most comparable M4, but it is $50 under the list price on 128GB model and $150 less than the 512GB.

For those not interested in the deep savings on the M3 model, here are the best deals on the M4 right now courtesy of Amazon:

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $650 (Reg. $749)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $749 (Reg. $849)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $949 (Reg. $1,049)

This 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air is $300 off new list price via official Apple refurb today

This morning we are circling back around to the official Apple Certified Refurbished storefront. While there are some more affordable models up for grabs at well below the MSRPs, Apple has re-stocked the 24GB/1TB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $300 off the new list price. 

Apple is now offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,699 shipped. This deal is live on the Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue models at the time of writing.

These things can sell out quick so get in there now if you’re interested.

This model carries a $1,999 list price in new condition at Apple, Amazon, and other retailers. Today’s deal scores you one of the more powerful M5 MacBook Air configs with the larger display at $300 less than that.

For comparison’s sake, this configuration is still listed up very close to the full MSRP with select models down in the $1,925 range on Amazon right now.

You will find select M5 Air models at $100 off via Amazon right now, and even $150 off on this one Sky Blue variant, but anything even mildly close to $300 under the new list prices is, or rather, has been, unheard of since Apple increased the prices across its MacBook and iPad lineups.

These deals also join a host of notable MacBook Pro offers and a range of particularly notable Apple deals going live this week as ushered in by the Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale:

More of this week’s best 60th Anniversary deals:

Apple’s 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro w/ 96W Power Adapter now $320 off in brand new condition

While are still tracking the most affordable M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM at $320 off, we also just spotted a chance to save just as much on the 24GB/1TB model as well.

B&H is now offering Apple’s 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB internal storage capacity down at $1,899 shipped.

Much like the 16GB model, B&H is also throwing in the upgraded 96W Apple Power Adapter with this deal – configuring this same machine with the upgraded charger would add an extra $20 to the total.

All in, you’re looking at a regularly $2,219 configuration down at $1,899 – today’s deal is $320 off the list price and the best we can find.

A 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro will cost you at least $2,049 at Amazon right now and it does not include the faster charger. It also hasn;t dropped anywhere near $1,899 since the price increase hit retail.

Just be sure to scope out some of the deep deals we are tracking over at the Apple refurb store on the more powerful M5 Pro machines too:

  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (Reg. $2,999 new)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (Reg. $3,599 new)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,719 (Reg. $3,199 new)

60th Anniversary Apple sale now live: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2 $120 off, AirTag 2 lows, iPhone Air $350 off, more

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker’s 45W Nano Smart Display charger is still down at $26 low, but this bundle adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more
  • Spigen’s Transparent Case adds retro iMac G3 vibes to M4 Mac mini at the $25 low
  • Anker’s 2026 Back to School sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear back to Prime Day lows from just $10 (46% off)
  • This Anker 8-outlet Power Strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Save up to 33% on Anker’s eufy C31 indoor/outdoor security camera, 2-packs, or a Homebase bundle starting from a $40 low
  • Anker flat plug 8-outlet Power Strip with USB now down at $24
  • Just $15 today gets you this Baseus 100W retractable USB-C cable that doubles as an Apple Watch charger (All-time low)

AirPods Max 2 just hit one of the best prices yet: Now $120 off in 60th Anniversary Sale

Update: Amazon is also now offering the Midnight AirPods Max 2 set down at the special $429 deal price – $120 off.

Now joining the AirPods Pro 3 deal at 25% off and the best price in over 6 months on AirPods 4 with ANC, the summer deals on AirPods Max 2 just got even better. You’ll now find them down at $120 off via Amazon and Best Buy as part of its now live 60th Anniversary Sale.

Best Buy has now launched a massive 60th Anniversary Sale loaded with Apple deals and Amazon is quickly price matching as we speak.

You’ll now find the latest 2026 AirPods Max 2 headphones sitting down at $429 shipped via Amazon and Best Buy to deliver one of the best deals we have tracked to date.

As of the time of writing, Best Buy has all five colors down at $429 shipped, and Amazon only has a few (but it will more than likely have all of them down this low very soon).

We had been tracking a solid $100 discount on the new Max 2 for the last week or so, and now things have dropped even lower and likely for most of this week (providing Amazon and Best Buy can keep all of the colors in stock). Outside of the limited Prime Day offer at $150 off, this is the lowest price we have tracked for Apple’s next-generation over-ear AirPods since release earlier this year.

Unlocked iPhone Air back at Black Friday pricing (nearly $160 off), open-box up to $350 off

Best Buy has now launched a massive 60th Anniversary Sale that is bringing back Black Friday pricing on iPhone Air (unlocked brand new).

As part of the now live 60th Anniversary Sale, Best Buy is now offering a particularly notable $159 off all iPhone Air models in brand new, unlocked condition to deliver the best price we can find from a reputable source:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (Reg. $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (Reg. $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (Reg. $1,400)

We recently featured Best Buy offering nearly $150 off all iPhone Air models as part of the Black Friday in July sale, but they are now even lower – this includes all colors on all three storage configurations.

While Amazon is either undercutting or matching Best Buy on most Apple gear right now as the sale goes live this morning, Best Buy has a lock on iPhone Air – Amazon does not officially carry brand new units.

If you’re looking to land an even lower price on iPhone Air, be sure to check out Best Buy’s “excellent” condition open-box units on this page under the “More options” link for each configuration – we are tracking as much as $350 or more off the new list prices here.

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $798 (Reg. $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $847 (Reg. $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $987 (Reg. $1,199)

Score a FREE $25 Starbucks gift card with your new MacBook Neo today, or get one at $120 off via Apple

The Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale is now full swing with thousands of price drops, 10x rewards bonuses for Plus/Total members, and more. Alongside some solid price drops on AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 landing this week, Best Buy is giving away a FREE $25 Starbucks gift card with MacBook Neo purchases (or you can skip that and grab one at $120 off via the Apple refurb store).

As part of its 60th Anniversary Sale, Best Buy is going to buy you a few cups of coffee at Starbucks with your MacBook Neo purchase from $699.

  • Buy a MacBook Neo and get a free $25 Starbucks gift card

It’s certainly not the actual cash discount we hoped for, but considering there has been almost no deals on Apple’s most affordable current-generation MacBook in new condition, we thought you might as well score some FREE Starbucks if you’re looking to grab one right now.

All of that said, if you ask me the best deal on the internet for MacBook Neo is actually coming straight from Apple. The Neo just saw a $100 price hike, but you can side step with the best refurbs you can buy over on the official renewed shop. There’s no free coffee here, but there are models starting at $599 right now and you’ll find as much as $120 off the 512GB model:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

All of these machines ship with:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale
